speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a rash on your scalp and forehead; can you describe exactly what the rash looks like and when it started?

speaker: Patient
text: 3-month-old boy. The parents report that the rash has been present for several weeks, noting that it sometimes appears red and scaly, especially during cold weather. The patient was born at 36 weeks' gestation and has been generally healthy since. The patient's father has a history of psoriasis.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Seborrheic dermatitis (cradle cap) in an infant, given the age, location, and familial history of psoriasis, though the "scaly" description warrants ruling out psoriasis.

REQUEST IMAGES: Scalp and forehead clinical photos.
REQUEST TEST: Skin_scrape_for_fungal_cultures if lesions are not responding to standard emollients.
